slides.author: Alexey Grigorev
slides.title: Scope before coding
slides.subtitle: A vague take-home is an engineering problem before it is a coding task.

slides.title: The assignment
slides.body: Build a Telegram bot for investment coaching with safety filtering. Useful idea, but too vague to implement directly.

slides.title: First step
slides.body: Clarify the user, allowed questions, refusal policy, data sources, and smallest useful version.

slides.title: Key constraint
slides.body: For this bot, the design depends on available public market data and a clear no-financial-advice boundary.

slides.title: What it shows
slides.body: A good take-home shows that you can turn an unclear request into a scoped engineering problem.
